facts.value: The application is made online through the central online portal for Master's programs at Goethe University in cooperation with uni-assist e.V.
Please upload all required documents, such as resumes and certificates, via the upload function in the uni-assist portal and assign them to your application.
No fees are charged for applications to Master's programs at Goethe University. No processing fee is to be paid to uni-assist.
For technical questions, please contact uni-assist directly.
For content-related questions about the application, please contact the study program advising.
Further information on the online application process can be found here: http://www2.uni-frankfurt.de/35791783.
